items.title: ChatGPT Lockdown Mode Bypass Reveals a Wider Challenge in AI Security
items.summary: Check Point Research found a way around ChatGPT's Lockdown Mode, a feature meant to limit data theft through prompt injection. The weakness was in the surrounding app rather than the model, and OpenAI fixed it by removing the sandbox permissions involved.

items.title: Explained: AI jailbreak - what is it, how does it work, why is it a concern
items.summary: An explainer on what AI jailbreaks are and why they matter, written around the Frontier Model Forum's new framework for assessing jailbreak risk.

items.title: Promising PS5 console jailbreak won't work on recent firmware as Sony combats exploits
items.summary: Reports that the 'Prolapse' effort aimed at PS5 firmware 14.00/14.10 hit a dead end. Sony patched the underlying vulnerability in 14.20, and the 14.22 update released November 2 added more security fixes.

items.title: Exclusive: AI security company Gray Swan launches Red Team Arena contest to jailbreak AI agents
items.summary: Gray Swan relaunched its public red-teaming platform as Arena 2.0, now focused on AI agents rather than chatbots. It offers a $300,000 prize pool sponsored by Anthropic, Meta, Google DeepMind and Reflection AI, with an emphasis on indirect prompt injection.

items.title: GoldHEN releases
items.summary: GoldHEN, the PS4 homebrew enabler, added firmware 13.52 support in v2.4b18.11 on September 20, 2026. v2.4b18.12 followed a day later with support for 13.02, 13.04 and 13.50.

items.title: Vulnerabilities - PS4 Developer wiki
items.summary: The PS4 developer wiki lists a kernel exploit chain by raw13g (AIO relapse plus slopkit) covering PS4 firmware 13.02–13.52, dated September 19, 2026. Firmware 14.00, released September 16, has no public exploit.

items.title: iOS 26 Gets First Jailbreak Thanks to Dopamine
items.summary: Dopamine 3.0 is the first public jailbreak for iOS 26, arriving 326 days after the OS launched. It supports only iOS 26.0–26.0.1, on older A12/A13-class devices.

items.title: New PS4 CSSFontFace exploit turns a font bug into a big deal
items.summary: Covers a WebKit CSSFontFace bug that gives a browser-level foothold on PS4 firmware 9.00. The article stresses it is not a full jailbreak of current system software on its own.

items.title: PS4 system software update 13.52
items.summary: Sony released PS4 system software 13.52 without warning. Unlike an earlier March 2026 update, it patches security vulnerabilities, which is bad news for the modding scene.

items.title: The "unhackable" Xbox One has been hacked — and Microsoft can't patch it
items.summary: Markus 'Doom' Gaasedelen presented 'Bliss' at RE//verse 2026, a voltage double-glitch attack on the original Xbox One's boot ROM that needs physical access. Because it is a hardware flaw, a software update can't fix it, and current Xbox Series consoles still have no public jailbreak.

items.title: PS5-Jailbreak kurz vor GTA 6: Hacker knackt offenbar Firmware 14.10 – aber eine Hürde bleibt
items.summary: German report that a hacker has apparently compromised PS5 firmware 14.10, the version tied to GTA 6, though an obstacle remains before it is a usable jailbreak. Other outlets dispute how far 14.10 work has progressed.

items.title: New PS5 jailbreak exploit works on systems running July 2026 firmware
items.summary: Covers the public 'Relapse' PS5 exploit chain by Nathan Fargo, released September 29, 2026, which spans firmware 7.00 through 13.60. At release it worked on everything except the then-new 14.00.

items.title: New PS5 jailbreak works on almost every firmware version
items.summary: TechSpot reports on the broad firmware coverage of the new public PS5 jailbreak chain, which reaches nearly every firmware released before 14.00.

items.title: New PS5 firmware update blocks Relapse jailbreak ahead of GTA 6 release
items.summary: Sony's PS5 14.10 system update closes the Relapse jailbreak method, ahead of GTA 6's launch.

items.title: New PS5 and PS4 jailbreak exploits trigger a 1,000 percent surge in prices for an obscure remaster of Star Wars Racer Revenge
items.summary: Used copies of the Star Wars Racer Revenge remaster jumped to around $300 after the game was linked to new PS4/PS5 exploits. A later GamesRadar report said the exploit might not work as hoped.

items.title: Hacker descobre método de desbloqueio para o firmware mais atual do PS4
items.summary: Brazilian report on developer Gezine's April 2026 claim of a PS4/PS5 zero-day kernel exploit shown on PS4 firmware 13.50. Gezine said they have no plans to release it.

items.title: Nintendo Switch 2 software jailbreak
items.summary: Developer pepsipu released NS2JB, a tethered, software-only userland exploit for the Switch 2 that runs through a backward-compatible Switch 1 game. It allows code execution but is not a full compromise: it can't run game backups and has to be redone at every launch.

items.title: Nintendo Doubles Down on Switch 2 Security, But Developer Gezine Cracks a Universal Exploit That Works Entirely Offline
items.summary: Gezine disclosed a userland exploit that works offline on both the Switch and Switch 2 without WebKit or save-file tricks. No kernel exploit or custom firmware accompanies it.

items.title: Root My Galaxy: Samsung temporary root exploit
items.summary: An open-source tool uses a Linux kernel exploit to give temporary root, via KernelSU, on older Snapdragon Galaxy flagships. Samsung was expected to patch it in a monthly security update.

items.title: Google Gemini Safety Bypass Lets Users Download AI-Generated Images That Its Own Filters Blocked
items.summary: Fog Security showed that Gemini's download feature could deliver images its chat-side safety filters had refused to display, without any jailbreak prompt. The issue had been reported to Google in June.

items.title: Hackers Turn to AI Jailbreak Bundles as Researchers Uncover New Prompt Adware Technique
items.summary: Check Point researchers describe 'jailbreak bundles' circulating among attackers, including one that repeatedly rewrites OpenAI Codex instructions to promote its author's commercial service, a technique they call prompt adware.

items.title: GenAI security November 2026: Workers AI leak, three vLLM flaws
items.summary: Monthly GenAI security roundup. It notes research where one tree-search attack bypassed six multi-scanner guardrail systems in every test, and another attack transferred to 29 unseen guardrails, including commercial black-box ones.

items.title: Adversarial Prompt Distillation: Efficient Jailbreak Attacks from Large to Small Language Models
items.summary: Peer-reviewed paper presenting a lightweight framework that distills jailbreak capability from large models into smaller ones. The authors argue it exposes new weaknesses in current LLM defenses.

items.title: BreakFun: Jailbreaking LLMs via Object Instantiation under Simulated Code Execution
items.summary: Research paper showing that framing a request as a simulated code-execution task can get LLMs past their safety alignment, highlighting a structural weak point in how models handle code-like prompts.

items.title: CASCADE Against Jailbreaks: Combination Across Stages with Controlled Attack-Defense Evaluation
items.summary: An arXiv preprint proposing a multi-stage defense against jailbreaks, tested in a controlled attack-versus-defense evaluation setup.

items.title: Kimi AI Was Jailbroken: Why Chatbots Aren't the Real Risk
items.summary: Discusses Mindgard's report that it bypassed the safety controls of Moonshot AI's Kimi K2.6 and K3 Swarm models. The researchers framed it as a failure of safety controls, not proof that the outputs were operationally valid.

items.title: Indirect Prompt Injection Goes Operational
items.summary: A CSA research note arguing that indirect prompt injection against AI agents has moved from proof-of-concept to live exploitation, citing 2026 incidents such as an agent deleting an inbox.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak News: 14.00 JB teaser, Kstuff 13.60 & FPKG support, GoldHEN 13.52, Homebrew & More
items.summary: News roundup covering a teased 14.00 jailbreak, Kstuff support for PS5 13.60, GoldHEN reaching PS4 firmware 13.52, and homebrew updates.

items.title: PS4/PS5 Jailbreak News: 13.52 Released, UltraC0re userland exploit, Netflix-N-Hack with P2JB & More!
items.summary: Reports on Sony's PS4 13.52 firmware patching an existing Blu-ray exploit, the new UltraC0re userland exploit, and P2JB support for Netflix-N-Hack.

items.title: The PS4 Just Got Its Biggest Jailbreak in Years
items.summary: Video coverage of the major 2026 PS4 jailbreak that extends support to recent 13.xx firmware.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak News : UserLand Exploit Discovered on Firmware 13.52
items.summary: Covers a report of what appears to be a userland vulnerability affecting PS4 firmware 13.52.

items.title: PS4 Jailbreak News Update : Use After Free triggered on Firmware 13.52
items.summary: Update on PS4 13.52 research: a use-after-free bug has reportedly been triggered on that firmware.

items.title: New PS4/PS5 Kernel Exploit Revealed but will it be released?
items.summary: Discusses a newly revealed PS4/PS5 kernel exploit and whether its developer will release it publicly.

items.title: PS5 Jailbreak News: 14.10/14.00 Prolapse, Steam on PS5, Linux Updates & More!
items.summary: PS5 scene roundup covering the announced Prolapse exploit for firmware 14.00/14.10, Steam running on PS5, and Linux loader updates.

items.title: PS5 Jailbreak: Bad News About Prolapse, & Other Solutions to Play GTA VI On Launch Day!
items.summary: Reports that the Prolapse exploit for PS5 14.00/14.10 appears to have failed because of a memory corruption issue.

items.title: EVERYTHING You Need To Know About The Switch 2 Jailbreak (It's Been A Wild Week)
items.summary: Recap of a busy week of Switch 2 hacking news, covering the userland exploits released and what they can and can't do.
